mapper.select: SELECT admission_year, province, subject_category, major_group, major_code, admission_major, college_name, COUNT(*) as admit_count, MIN(score) as min_score, MAX(score) as max_score, ROUND(AVG(score), 1) as avg_score, MIN(score_rank) as highest_rank, MAX(score_rank) as lowest_rank FROM admission_full_record WHERE admission_year = #{admissionYear} GROUP BY admission_year, province, subject_category, major_group, major_code, admission_major, college_name ORDER By admission_year, province, subject_category, major_group, major_code, admission_major, college_name
